items.title: แรงที่จุดค้ำทันทีหลังเอาอีกจุดค้ำออก
items.source: ข้อ 2: แรงที่จุดค้ำทันทีหลังเอาอีกจุดค้ำออก. MC2 figure: uniform rod M, length L, horizontal on supports A (L/4 from the left end) and B (right end). Just after B is pulled away the rod pivots about A: N_A = Mg (L^2/12)/(L^2/12 + d^2) with d = L/2 - pL the pivot-to-centre distance; p = 1/4 gives 4Mg/7 (answer 1). Returns N_A in newtons, g = 10.
items.figure: MC2 figure: uniform rod M, length L, horizontal on supports A (L/4 from the left end) and B (right end). Just after B is pulled away the rod pivots about A: N_A = Mg (L^2/12)/(L^2/12 + d^2) with d = L/2 - pL the pivot-to-centre distance; p = 1/4 gives 4Mg/7 (answer 1). Returns N_A in newtons, g = 10.

items.title: แรงเฉลี่ยของหยดน้ำกระแทกกำแพง
items.source: ข้อ 4: แรงเฉลี่ยของหยดน้ำกระแทกกำแพง. MC4 figure: a liquid drop (mass m, radius r) moving at v splats on a rigid wall without rebounding. Its momentum m v is removed in the time its far side takes to reach the wall, 2r/v, so the average force is m v^2/(2r) (answer 4). Grams, m/s, cm -> newtons.

items.title: ความต้านทานที่ให้กระแสเท่ากันสองวงจร
items.source: ข้อ 8: ความต้านทานที่ให้กระแสเท่ากันสองวงจร. MC8 figure: picture a: source E with internal r feeding two resistors in parallel; I is the current in one. Picture b: the same source with a single x carries the same I. For branches R1 (other) and R2 (the one with I): x = R2 + r R2 / R1; equal R gives x = r + R (answer 2). Ohms.
items.figure: MC8 figure: picture a: source E with internal r feeding two resistors in parallel; I is the current in one. Picture b: the same source with a single x carries the same I. For branches R1 (other) and R2 (the one with I): x = R2 + r R2 / R1; equal R gives x = r + R (answer 2). Ohms.

items.figure: MC9: psi = sin(x - t) + sin(x + t) = 2 sin x cos t; at t = pi it is -2 sin x (answer 3). Adapted: the value of psi at given x and t, both multiples of pi/6.

items.source: ข้อ 11: ระดับน้ำเมื่อน้ำแข็งลอยละลาย. MC11: ice (0.92 g/cm^3, 200 cm^3) floats in water in a cup of section 100 cm^2; melting leaves the level unchanged (answer 1). Adapted: the liquid may be denser (brine of density rho); the level rises by m (1/rho_water - 1/rho) / A. cm.

items.title: ประจุในตัวเก็บประจุของวงจร RC สองชั้น
items.source: ข้อ 13: ประจุในตัวเก็บประจุของวงจร RC สองชั้น. MC13 figure: E in series with R and C to a node; the lower R and the starred C* sit in parallel from that node to the bottom wire; switch SW closes at t = 0 with no charge anywhere. No current flows at steady state, so C* charges then empties: rise to a peak, decay to zero (answer 2). Returns the curve's shape for the named capacitor.

items.source: ข้อ 17: ความยาวโฟกัสของเลนส์ที่กลับผิว. MC17 figure: lens A, a converging meniscus with R1 then R2 (both centres to the right), has 1/f_A = (mu - 1)(1/R1 - 1/R2). Lens B carries the same two surfaces in the other order, R2 then R1, curving the same way: thick at the edge, 1/f_B = (1 - mu)(1/R1 - 1/R2) (answer 3). cm.

items.source: ข้อ 25: อัตราส่วนมวลลูกตุ้มที่ชนแล้วติดกัน. Short25 figure: pendulum bob M released from the height of its pivot (string horizontal) swings down, sticks to m at rest at the bottom, and the pair rises to 60 deg from the vertical. (M/(M+m))^2 = 1 - cos 60, so M/m = sqrt2 + 1. Adapted: any final angle, given by its cosine.

items.title: มุมเอียงของแผ่นที่ห้อยมวลที่มุม
items.source: ข้อ 28: มุมเอียงของแผ่นที่ห้อยมวลที่มุม. Worked28 figure: uniform plate M, length L, width b, hung by a string at A, the midpoint of its top edge; m hangs from corner B at the lower end. The plate tilts theta, B side down. Balance of moments about A: M (b/2) sin = m ((L/2) cos - b sin), so tan theta = m L / (b (M + 2m)).
